verdict.rationale: Retell provides all three requested channels: official Node/Python SDKs and REST API, an official CLI to manage agents/phone numbers from the terminal, and an official MCP server letting MCP clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code) create/update/publish agents. Docs also show number assignment and call-placement flows (assign agent to number, test call) achievable via API/SDK rather than only dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit end-to-end example showing a single agent script/CLI/MCP session that creates an agent, attaches a number, AND places a call in one flow, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of CLI/MCP provisioning working hands-on.
